lede: The most consequential meeting this week is the Ouray County BOCC on Monday, November 10, where two public hearings are on the docket — a PUD request to split a 14-acre parcel on County Road 1 and a 2026 budget amendment — plus a vote on whether to repeal an austerity resolution passed last year. San Miguel County's Planning Commission follows on Wednesday with a work session on the Affordable Housing Impact Mitigation Fee, a structure that directly shapes whether workforce housing gets built here. Ouray's Planning Commission also meets Monday to take up a proposed ordinance on natural medicine restrictions.
